meta.name: Sandisk Corporation
meta.built: live research (Yahoo Finance feeds via the Claude app browser)

consensus.note: Built from Yahoo Finance consensus. Base-case growth starts at consensus revenue for the next two fiscal years and fades after that.

peers.note: Peer list starts from Yahoo's related-symbols feed (stocks viewed together), not an industry screen. Edit it to true comparables.

history.annual_note: Yahoo Finance standardised statements. Operating income can differ from the company's GAAP line where Yahoo normalises unusual items.

bridge_note: Captive-finance arms and non-operating investments are not in Yahoo's feed. Check the 10-K and enter them if the company has them.

notes.erp: Damodaran implied ERP, Jan-2026 (edit to update)
notes.rm: Rm = 10Y yield + ERP (5.12% + 4.23%). Replace with your own expected S&P 500 return.
notes.segments: Single revenue line. Split into reported segments for a sell-side-grade model.
notes.operating: Margins: TTM 61.6%, 4-year average 10.1%, low -21.3%. D&A and capex are 3-year averages of sales.
notes.comps: All multiples come from the same vendor, so definitions match across peers.

sources.Daily prices and beta regression: Yahoo Finance chart API (adjusted closes) for SNDK and ^GSPC, 2025-02-14 to 2026-10-20
sources.Cost of debt: Synthetic rating AAA from interest coverage 170.8x (Damodaran large-firm table)
sources.Peers: Yahoo related symbols: 000660.KS, 005930.KS, 285A.T, MU, STX, WDC

market.shares_basic: Yahoo Finance quoteSummary defaultKeyStatistics.impliedSharesOutstanding (checked against marketCap ÷ price)
market.dilution: Yahoo Finance fundamentals (quarterly): diluted average shares − ordinary shares, latest quarter
y1_segments.total: Yahoo Finance quoteSummary earningsTrend 0y revenue estimate (consensus)
scenarios.Bear.margins.total.0: lower of consensus-implied and TTM operating margin
scenarios.Bear.margins.total.1: multi-year average margin (the lowest year is a loss)
scenarios.Base.margins.total.0: Yahoo Finance quoteSummary consensus FY27 EPS × diluted shares ÷ (1 − tax) + interest, ÷ consensus revenue (consensus EPS may be on an adjusted basis)
scenarios.Base.margins.total.1: midpoint of TTM and multi-year average margin
scenarios.Bull.margins.total.0: higher of consensus-implied and TTM operating margin
operating.da_pct: Yahoo Finance fundamentals (annual) D&A ÷ revenue, 3-year average
operating.capex_pct: Yahoo Finance fundamentals (annual) capex ÷ revenue, 3-year average
operating.nwc_pct: Yahoo Finance fundamentals (quarterly) (receivables + inventory − payables) ÷ (4 × revenue), quarter to 2026-06-30
operating.nwc0: Yahoo Finance fundamentals (quarterly) receivables + inventory − payables, 2026-06-30; year 1 change = NWC % × revenue − this level
operating.buyback_pct: Yahoo Finance fundamentals (annual) share-count decline per year, last 2 years
timing.first_period: days from 2026-10-20 to fiscal year end 2027-07-03
timing.stub: share of the year after the last balance sheet (2026-06-30)
capital.kd_pretax: rf + AAA spread; coverage = operating income ÷ interest expense
bridge.core_debt: Yahoo Finance fundamentals (quarterly) TotalDebt − capital leases, 2026-06-30
bridge.investments: not in feed; enter from the 10-K
relative.weights.pe_fwd: forward P/E only (sales ramping: trailing multiples left out)
relative.weights.ev_ebitda: forward P/E only (sales ramping: trailing multiples left out)
relative.weights.ev_sales: forward P/E only (sales ramping: trailing multiples left out)
quality_data: Yahoo Finance fundamentals (annual): revenue, cost of revenue, SG&A, receivables, current assets, net PP&E, total assets, current liabilities, long-term debt, D&A, net income (continuing), operating cash flow
model: routed from Yahoo industry "Computer Hardware" → FCFF DCF; change on the DES tab

warnings.msg: Worst annual margin -21.3% is a loss; Bear fades to the 4-year average 10.1% instead
Consensus EPS implies a 77.6% operating margin next year against 61.6% trailing; Base year 1 uses consensus
Latest quarter annualised is 1.77x trailing revenue; trailing EV/EBITDA and EV/Sales understate the business, so comps use forward P/E only
